response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates extensive fullstack experience with deep expertise in TypeScript, React, and Node.js, aligning well with the required skills. His background includes scalable systems (e.g., Direct Mail automation at Optilyz, real-time data at Dunnhumby) and clean architecture practices (TDD, CI/CD at RIDE Capital). However, his PostgreSQL experience is not explicitly highlighted, and his recent roles skew toward seniority rather than entry-level pragmatism.
strengths: Extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js
Proven scalability work with high-traffic systems (e.g., Dunnhumby's micro-services)
Strong DevOps and CI/CD practices (TDD, Kubernetes, Docker) aligning with clean architecture
concerns: Lack of explicit PostgreSQL experience in resume highlights
Senior-level roles may overshoot the entry-level job scope
Minimal mention of energy/construction tech domain exposure
